verdict.rationale: Verifiable agent identity is a fair question for an agentic-commerce payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent features: agent-platform integrations, ACP/UCP tokens bound to a checkout session and merchant identifier, and generic fraud screening. None of these documents registered agent profiles, request signatures, or trust tiers that let a merchant tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots
